purpose: Test whether a strong deployment model consumes a stateful causal constraint frontier more effectively than the frozen flat constraint projection.
claim_scope: Consumed development-case mechanism qualification only; no held-out, generalization, significance, or leaderboard claim.

mechanism_qualification.source: Cases were selected post hoc from the frozen P4 trajectory census because they instantiate two replicated failure mechanisms.

cases.target_mechanism: cross-repository replication of the PyO3/Python compatibility frontier
many surface import obligations amplified by one executable missing dependency

held_constant: candidate, environment, command, wall-clock, and provider safety limits
treatment_does_not: restrict the model to a closed operation vocabulary
block a candidate because it disagrees with the frontier
discard raw execution or verifier evidence
use official evaluator feedback inside the episode

execution.parallelization: Three independent case lanes run concurrently; the two conditions within each case run sequentially.
execution.condition_order: AB for LangGraph, BA for Nonebot2, AB for Conan
execution.token_policy: Token count and estimated price are reported outcomes. The configured 100M-token and USD 1000 limits are emergency guards, not intended experimental stopping thresholds.

primary_outcomes: official evaluator pass for each paired episode
internal certification for each paired episode
target causal-root recurrence across successive candidate decision states
candidate index of target causal-root closure
secondary_outcomes: input, output, cache-read, and total tokens
estimated price under the frozen accounting snapshot
mechanism_success_rule: Proceed to a fresh frozen Dev qualification only if the treatment improves target-root closure or official success on at least one pair, worsens official success on no pair, and introduces no new measurement-integrity or candidate-interface failure.
failure_rule: If the frontier is present but ignored, stale, misleading, or associated with worse paired outcomes, inspect the trajectories and revise or remove the smallest responsible mechanism before consuming fresh cases.
infrastructure_policy: Archive and exclude attempts that fail before candidate execution because of host, credential, network, provider, repository-acquisition, or container infrastructure. Reruns retain provenance and do not replace algorithmic failures.
prediction: The causal profile will close the explicit runtime frontier earlier on at least one of the two PyO3 cases and will reduce repeated surface-symptom handling on Conan without reducing paired official success.
